steps.description: AC-1: Confirm `/release` writes sprint-scoped notes only to canonical path `handoffs/releases/Sxxxx-release-notes.md` and does not overwrite other sprint notes.
AC-2: Confirm canonical queue artifact `handoffs/release_queue.md` exists with required fields (`sprint_id`, `status`, `last_updated`, `release_notes_ref`).
AC-3: Confirm deterministic queue update semantics for target sprint (`ready -> unreleased -> released`) with target-row-only mutation.
AC-4: Confirm unresolved sprint identity fails closed (`RELEASE_SPRINT_UNRESOLVED`) and does not overwrite notes or mutate unrelated queue rows.
AC-5: Confirm one-time legacy migration/backfill preserves `handoffs/release_notes.md`, supports resolvable migration, and remains idempotent.
AC-6: Confirm backward compatibility for workflows reading legacy `handoffs/release_notes.md` pointer/latest summary behavior.
AC-7: Confirm release readiness/reporting surfaces unreleased queue entries before finalization.
AC-8: Confirm release command/rules/docs define ownership and phase touchpoints for queue transitions and note generation.
AC-9: Confirm active/template parity for release guidance and artifacts (`release` command, rules, runbook, README, queue, sprint notes template).

planned_cases.scenario: Unresolved sprint identity in release flow
Legacy migration without resolvable sprint context
Queue entry missing for target sprint
